title: This is how I used AI to create the initial concept for my character, and this is the final result.
author: VeylorLabs

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: I think so. You put in the work, which includes actual design rather than just a prompt.

replies.author: VeylorLabs
replies.body: yes, it has a lot of work

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: Looks good, I'm trying a 3d character myself but ai generated mesh has proved less than stellar. Did you build your own topology?

replies.author: VeylorLabs
replies.body: I only used AI for the concept stage and to create the low-poly model. Everything else was made by hand.

replies.author: Cubey42
replies.body:
Nice, yeah after messing with a mesh I've been cleaning up I think the reality is just to build it by hand so it's clean. What I really wanted to do was get a model in unity but learning bones has been a bit of a nightmare. My feet bones are broken and I'm not sure why.

Great stuff though

comments.author: loontoon
comments.body:
Your character looks superb to me. 

Of course there's a lot more to a game than just the character. 

Keep us updated as you progress.
